title: First-unit inspection
passage: Good morning, team. Beginning tomorrow, the first unit produced after each model change must be checked by a quality inspector before the line returns to normal speed. This requirement applies even when the fixture has not been replaced. Place the unit on the yellow inspection shelf and enter its serial number in the tablet at the station. Please do not leave samples on the supervisor's desk. During today's afternoon break, I will demonstrate the new entry screen beside Line One. If the inspector is unavailable, keep the line paused and contact the quality desk.
passageZh: 各位早安。從明天開始，每次切換機種後生產的第一件產品，都必須經品質檢驗員確認，產線才能恢復正常速度。即使治具沒有更換，這項規定仍適用。請把產品放在黃色檢驗架上，並在工作站的平板輸入序號。請不要把樣品放在主管桌上。今天下午休息時間，我會在一號線旁示範新的輸入畫面。如果檢驗員無法到場，請維持停線並聯絡品質服務窗口。
